_note: Layout template for the Phase 1 test assignment, in the exact shape the ingestion pipeline consumes (ingestion.models.AssignmentTemplate / QuestionSpec / Region). ingestion v1's AssignmentTemplate has no page dimension: its segmentation applies one template per page (see ingestion/segmentation.py, 'page index is aligned to template pages 1:1'), so the two printed pages are stored as two per-page templates under 'pages' and tools/run_end_to_end.py builds one AssignmentTemplate per page from them. Regions are normalized page coordinates (0.0-1.0), declarative approximations of the rendered sheets produced by tools/build_papers.py. Part ids follow ingestion/fixtures.py conventions: 'a'/'b'/'c' for sub-questions, 'blank1'..'blank3' for multi-blank fill-ins; a whole-question region is stored under the empty-string key.
